name: Tallpaw the Tabby Cat
blurb: Tallpaw, a fluffy brown tabby with a white bib, white front legs and pale green eyes, rises on her hind legs to see over everyone.

name: Hearthbib the Fluffy Cat
blurb: Hearthbib, a long-haired brown tabby with a snowy chest, white socks and tufted ears, dozes by the stone hearth and sits up at each creak.

name: Stilts the Upright Cat
blurb: Stilts, a slim brown tabby with a white nose blaze and white forepaws, stands straight up on her back legs when the tall grass rustles.
